run healthz readyz and v2 bootstrap smoke after traffic shift

infra_consumes.local_scope: Infra owns topology, drift policy, IAM, and operator evidence. It does not own runtime artifact CD execution.

dependency_direction.top_down: Runtime artifact CD behavior changes in control-plane first; infra consumes the required topology/evidence needs.
dependency_direction.bottom_up: Infra may discover topology or security constraints and request a control-plane workflow change, but that does not move CD execution out of control-plane.
